Class RplidarA2

java.lang.Object
io.github.jabrena.juno.hardware.device.lidar.RplidarA2
public final class RplidarA2 extends Object
A Slamtec RPLIDAR A2 (A2M8) 360-degree laser scanner reached through its USB adapter, whose CP2102 bridge sits on a UsbHostShield. The A2M8 talks at 115200 baud and sets its motor speed from a SET_MOTOR_PWM command, which startMotor() sends: without it the head stands still and a scan is acknowledged but delivers no measurements. 
UsbHostShield usb = new UsbHostShield();
RplidarA2 lidar = new RplidarA2(new Cp210xSerial(usb));   // once, at startup
int[] scan = new int[RplidarA2.DEGREES];                  // distance in mm per whole degree, 0 = no return
if (usb.begin() && lidar.begin() && lidar.startScan()) {
    while (true) {
        if (lidar.poll(scan)) {
            // a full revolution is in scan
        }
    }
}

Allocation: the constructor allocates the 360-entry working scan and two small buffers; poll(int[]) and every other call are allocation-free. Call poll(int[]) continuously while scanning: the lidar sends about 10 KB per second and the bridge buffers only half a second of it.

  • Constructor Details

    • RplidarA2

      public RplidarA2(Cp210xSerial serial)

  • Method Details

    • begin

      public boolean begin()
      Opens the adapter's bridge at BAUD_RATE and stops any scan still running. The motor stays as it was: call startMotor() before scanning. Returns false when the adapter is not attached or is not a CP210x.

    • startMotor

      public boolean startMotor()
      Spins the motor up at DEFAULT_MOTOR_PWM. Allow a second or two before scanning.

    • stopMotor

      public boolean stopMotor()
      Stops the motor; a running scan stops delivering measurements.

    • setMotorPwm

      public boolean setMotorPwm(int pwm)
      Sets the motor speed, 0 (stopped) to MAX_MOTOR_PWM; a value outside is clamped. Faster is a shorter revolution with fewer points per degree. Returns false when the command could not be sent.

    • stop

      public void stop()
      Stops scanning and drops what is still in flight. The lidar stays powered and its motor keeps spinning.

    • reset

      public void reset()
      Reboots the lidar's core, which clears a protection stop; takes about a second.

    • health

      public int health()
      The lidar's health: HEALTH_GOOD, HEALTH_WARNING, HEALTH_ERROR or HEALTH_NO_ANSWER.

    • info

      public boolean info(int[] info)
      Fills info with the model, firmware major and minor version, and hardware revision. Returns false when the lidar did not answer.

    • startScan

      public boolean startScan()
      Starts the measurement stream. Returns false when the lidar does not acknowledge it.

    • poll

      public boolean poll(int[] scan)
      Reads what the lidar sent since the last call. When a revolution completes, copies it into scan (360 distances in millimetres, 0 where no return came back) and returns true; otherwise leaves scan alone and returns false.

    • isConnected

      public boolean isConnected()
      Whether the adapter is still open: false once it was unplugged or stopped answering, after which begin() enumerates it again.

    • revolutions

      public int revolutions()
      Complete revolutions poll(int[]) has returned since the last startScan().

    • nodes

      public int nodes()
      Measurement nodes received since the last startScan(), valid or not.
